name: OPA1692 / OPA1694
tagline: Only 650 µA per channel, yet 4.2 nV/√Hz and −127 dB distortion; a favourite for low-power audio builds.

lineage.note: Sole source; SoundPlus line, first datasheet SBOS566 June 2017. Related to OPA166x (OPA1662/OPA1664).

part_numbers.note: Base part, datasheet SBOS566; SOIC-8 (D) and VSSOP-8 (DGK). Lifecycle label unconfirmed.
SOIC-8 (D), tube / tape-and-reel. Marking OP1692. In Nov 2018 notice.
VSSOP-8 (DGK), tape and reel. In Nov 2018 notice.
VSSOP-8 (DGK), small reel. In Nov 2018 notice; current orderability unchecked.
Quad (SOIC-14/TSSOP-14) in original SBOS566; dropped in rev A, release unconfirmed.

reputation.summary: Cycfi Research (2017) found it fast, dynamic and well-timed on most CDs, though the LME49723 separated instruments better on one track. Head-Fi's Opamp thread ranks it among the best on specs with the OPA2209 and OPA2189, and preferred to the OPA1678. Praise rests on a few listener reports, not measurements.
typical_uses: Op-amp rolling in DIP-8 sockets via SOIC adapters
caveats: SMD only (SOIC-8, VSSOP-8); DIP sockets need an adapter.
Cycfi preferred the LME49723 for instrument separation on one track.
Praise rests on a small number of subjective reports.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit reports found. Genuine top marking is 'OP1692'. eBay sellers offer OPA1692IDR pre-soldered on DIP-8 adapters. Buy from TI, Mouser, Digi-Key or Farnell and check the marking, TI logo and date code.

silicon_changes.summary: No silicon change is known. TI's only notice is a datasheet-only spec change (SBOS566B to SBOS566C) 'to accurately reflect device characteristics'. Changed parameters were not retrieved, so rev B or earlier figures may differ from rev C.
silicon_changes.identification: None needed: the silicon did not change. Only datasheet limits and typicals differ between SBOS566B and SBOS566C.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected; same die. Use rev C values when comparing specs.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: datasheet-only change; the notice says the device is unchanged.
silicon_changes.verification: TI notice (Farnell copy) and rev C datasheet copy confirm a datasheet-only change.

revision_history.changes: First release, Advance Information. Covered OPA1692 dual and OPA1694 quad (SOIC-14/TSSOP-14). The ic114 copy holds this edition.
Advance Information to Production Data; all OPA1694 references removed. Date confirmed by the radiolocman copy (di=486003) and TI E2E.
Exists as the 'before' version in the Nov 2018 notice; dated between Dec 2017 and Oct 2018. Contents unknown.
Spec changes 'to accurately reflect device characteristics'; no device change (TI notice 2018-11-05). Exact parameters not retrieved. Latest found.

revision_chains.note: Rev B date and changes unknown; no copy identified. No revision after C found.

open_questions: Date and contents of SBOS566B, and which specs changed B to C (and the notice number)?
Is there a revision after C? Was the OPA1694 quad ever released to production?
Confirm 5.1 MHz GBW and 23 V/µs slew against the rev C table.
Confirm the 3.5–36 V supply range and ±50 mA output current.
Lifecycle of each orderable (especially OPA1692IDGKT); revisions held by alldatasheet, Digi-Key and datasheet4u copies.

claims_confirmed: Datasheet SBOS566: rev C October 2018, original June 2017 (https://www.scribd.com/document/394624916/sbos566c, https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/2721178.pdf).
TI product page references Rev. C (https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1692).
Rev A moved Advance Information to Production Data (https://www.ti.com/lit/gpn/OPA1692).
Rev A (Dec 2017) removed OPA1694 references, per TI E2E (https://e2e.ti.com/support/amplifiers-group/amplifiers/f/amplifiers-forum/630559/opa1692-quad-version-opa1694-unfindable).
Notice 2018-11-05: SBOS566B to SBOS566C spec change, no device change; ID/IDGKR/IDGKT/IDR (https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/2721178.pdf).
Original SBOS566 covered OPA1692 and OPA1694 quad (http://product.ic114.com/PDF/O/OPA1692.PDF, https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/954304/TI1/OPA1694.html).
4.2 nV/√Hz and −127 dB distortion at 1 kHz (https://www.alldatasheet.com/html-pdf/954302/TI1/OPA1692/294/5/OPA1692.html).
650 µA/ch, output within 200 mV into 2 kΩ, 5.1 MHz, 23 V/µs (https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1692).
corrections: Channels corrected from 0 to 2; added IDR, IDGKR, IDGKT orderables and the OPA1694 quad.
Statuses changed from unknown to active (TI pages live); OPA1692IDGKT stays unknown.
Added SBOS566 rev C and its history: original 2017-06, A 2017-12, B undated, C 2018-10.
Added the 2018-11-05 datasheet-only change notice as a low-risk entry.
Supply range (3.5–36 V) and ±50 mA output kept but unconfirmed.
